question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Peacock Garden’?
solution:
The correct answer is __Anita Desai__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Anita Desai is the author of the book The Peacock Garden”.
 
• The book is about the story of a young girl obsessed by a childhood prophecy of disaster.
 
• It is a commentary on the marital relations of such wives and husbands who belong to different strata of society.
 
• Anita Desai Wins of the Sahitya Akademi Award for this book. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indu Sundaresan
 
 
• An Indian-American author known for her historical fiction.
 
• Famous Works:
 
• The Twentieth Wife (based on the life of Mehrunissa, who became Empress Nur Jahan).
 
• The Feast of Roses (a sequel to The Twentieth Wife).
 
 
 
• Arundhati Roy
 
 
• An Indian author and activist.
 
• Famous Works:
 
• The God of Small Things (won the Booker Prize in 1997).
 
• The Ministry of Utmost Happiness.
 
• Known for her political essays and activism on social justice and environmental issues.
 
 
 
• Shashi Deshpande
 
 
• A renowned Indian novelist and short story writer.
 
• Famous Works:
 
• That Long Silence (won the Sahitya Akademi Award).
 
• The Dark Holds No Terrors.
 
• Explores themes like gender, family dynamics, and identity in her works.
